content: Govern and implement the replacement of the static Codex, Claude Code, and ZCode commit-identity table with automatic runtime harness-subject discovery and deterministic identity derivation, while preserving human Git configuration and all historical commit evidence.

Activated D0028/SC0004: the runtime harness subject replaces the static Codex, Claude Code, and ZCode mapping table as the authority for both Git Author and Committer; missing or ambiguous evidence fails without falling back to human Git configuration.

Published transient D0028 migration guidance G004 to S0100-20260828-013-m0100-foundation and G007 to S0100-20260830-001-m0100-completion-sprint; each target owner will disposition and remove its packet at the next control boundary.
